segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Well, most people think that lions only come from Africa.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And you would be forgiven for thinking this, because in fact most lions do come from Africa.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: But this hasn't always been the case.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If we go back ten thousand years we would find that there were lions roaming vast sections of the globe.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: But now, unfortunately, only very small sections of the lions' former habitat remain.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: My particular interest is Asiatic lions, which are a sub-species of African lions.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's almost a hundred thousand years since the Asiatic lions split off and developed as a sub-species.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: At one time the Asiatic lion was living as far west as Greece and they were found from there, in a band that spread east through various countries of the Middle East, all the way to India.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In museums, you can now see Greek coins that have clear images of the Asiatic lion on them.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Most of them are dated at around 500 B.C.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: However, Europe saw its last Asiatic lion roaming free two thousand years ago.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Over the next nineteen hundred years the numbers of Asiatic lions in the other areas declined steadily, but it was only in the nineteenth century that they disappeared from everywhere but India.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So, how can you tell an Asiatic lion from an African lion, with which you're probably more familiar?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Well, in general, Asiatic lions are not as big as African lions.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The colour is more or less the same, but the appearance of the mane is different- that's the hair around the lion's face and neck.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The Asiatic lion's mane is noticeably shorter than the African lion's.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Asiatic lions also have a long fold of skin on their undersides. whereas not many African lions have this.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Well, I'd like to talk to you now about the Gir Sanctuary in India.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: That's where I've just come back from.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The sanctuary was established specifically to protect the Asiatic lion.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's 1.450 square kilometres in area and most of it is forest.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are now around three hundred Asiatic lions in India and almost all of them are in this sanctuary.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: But despite living in a sanctuary, which makes them safe from hunters, they still face a number of problems that threaten their survival.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One of these is the ever-present danger of disease.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This is what killed more than a third of Africa's Serengeti lions in 1994, and people are fearful that something similar could happen in the Gir Sanctuary and kill off many of the Asiatic lions there.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: India's lions are particularly vulnerable because they have a limited gene pool.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The reason for this is interesting- it's because all of them are descended from a few dozen lions that were saved by a prince who took a particular interest in them.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: He was very wealthy, ~nd he managed to protect them - otherwise they'd probably have died out completely.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: When you see the Asiatic lion in India, what you sense is enormous vitality.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: They're very impressive beasts and you would never guess that they had this vulnerability when you look at them.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The Asiatic lions don't have the Gir Sanctuary to themselves, I should add.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: They actually share it with about two thousand farmers.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: A significant proportion of the lions' diet is made up of the livestock of these farmers -goats, chickens and so on - as much as a third, in fact.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And they've even been known to attack humans, especially in times of drought.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One final piece of interesting information - in ancient India one of the greatest tests of leadership for a man was to fight a lion.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now it seems, in modern India it will be a great test to see if the lion can be saved.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I'm sure this is something that all of you will share concern for too.
